summary: EmailPopupDocument represents documents used in email popups, including metadata like file name and path.
purpose: To manage and display documents in email popups within the HSPnet framework.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the email popup document.

fields.name: FileName
fields.description: Name of the file associated with the email popup document.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.description: Path where the file is stored.

fields.name: Checked
fields.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the document is checked.

workflows.name: Email Document Management
steps: Search for documents using specified data information.
Delete documents by file path and manage associated directories.
